verses.en_bbe: And Elihu made answer and said,

verses.en: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God’s?
verses.pt: Tens por direito dizeres: Maior é a minha justiça do que a de Deus?
verses.en_web: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’
verses.en_bbe: Does it seem to you to be right, and righteousness before God, to say,

verses.en: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?
verses.pt: Porque dizes: Que me aproveita? Que proveito tenho mais do que se eu tivera pecado?
verses.en_web: That you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?’
verses.en_bbe: What profit is it to me, and how am I better off than if I had done wrong?

verses.en: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.
verses.pt: Eu te darei respostas, a ti e aos teus amigos contigo.
verses.en_web: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
verses.en_bbe: I will make answer to you and to your friends:

verses.en: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.
verses.pt: Atenta para os céus, e vê; e contempla o firmamento que é mais alto do que tu.
verses.en_web: Look to the heavens, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
verses.en_bbe: Let your eyes be turned to the heavens, and lifted up to see the skies; they are higher than you.

verses.en: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?
verses.pt: Se pecares, que efetuarás contra ele? Se as tuas transgressões se multiplicarem, que lhe farás com isso?
verses.en_web: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
verses.en_bbe: If you have done wrong, is he any the worse for it? and if your sins are great in number, what is it to him?

verses.en: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?
verses.pt: Se fores justo, que lhe darás, ou que receberá ele da tua mão?
verses.en_web: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
verses.en_bbe: If you are upright, what do you give to him? or what does he take from your hand?

verses.en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.
verses.pt: A tua impiedade poderia fazer mal a outro tal como tu; e a tua justiça poderia aproveitar a um filho do homem.
verses.en_web: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
verses.en_bbe: Your evil-doing may have an effect on a man like yourself, or your righteousness on a son of man.

verses.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.pt: Por causa da multidão das opressões os homens clamam; clamam por socorro por causa do braço dos poderosos.
verses.en_web: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.en_bbe: Because the hand of the cruel is hard on them, men are making sounds of grief; they are crying out for help because of the arm of the strong.

verses.en: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;
verses.pt: Mas ninguém diz: Onde está Deus meu Criador, que inspira canções durante a noite;
verses.en_web: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
verses.en_bbe: But no one has said, Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night;

verses.en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
verses.pt: que nos ensina mais do que aos animais da terra, e nos faz mais sábios do que as aves do céu?
verses.en_web: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
verses.en_bbe: Who gives us more knowledge than the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the heaven?

verses.en: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.pt: Ali clamam, porém ele não responde, por causa da arrogância os maus.
verses.en_web: There they cry, but no one gives answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.en_bbe: There they are crying out because of the pride of the evil-doers, but he gives them no answer.

verses.en: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.pt: Certo é que Deus não ouve o grito da vaidade, nem para ela atentará o Todo-Poderoso.
verses.en_web: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.en_bbe: But God will not give ear to what is false, or the Ruler of all take note of it;

verses.en: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.
verses.pt: Quanto menos quando tu dizes que não o vês. A causa está perante ele; por isso espera nele.
verses.en_web: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!
verses.en_bbe: How much less when you say that you do not see him; that the cause is before him, and you are waiting for him.

verses.en: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:
verses.pt: Mas agora, porque a sua ira ainda não se exerce, nem grandemente considera ele a arrogância,
verses.en_web: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance.

verses.en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.
verses.pt: por isso abre Jó em vão a sua boca, e sem conhecimento multiplica palavras.
verses.en_web: Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
verses.en_bbe: And Job's mouth is open wide to give out what is of no profit, increasing words without knowledge.
